summary: RF-FALCON-IDS: a high-end ROLEPLAY-only ID ordering and management website with a dark futuristic government/military aesthetic, Internet Identity authentication, user dashboards and order history, ID order form with live ID card preview, export/print, and an admin panel to manage orders and statuses.
architectural_notes: Authentication will use Internet Identity (no username/password; admin access granted via designated identity).
Include prominent on-site disclaimers: ROLEPLAY USE ONLY / NOT REAL IDENTIFICATION.
Data storage approach should be backend-ready; initial implementation may use simplest persistence approach compatible with chosen auth.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- RF-FALCON-IDS wordmark/logo in a dark futuristic government/military style (rf-falcon-ids-logo.dim_1200x300.png)
- Set of 50 minimalist state seal icons, one per U.S. state, monochrome/duotone to match neon cyan/purple theme, consistent style (state-seals-pack.dim_256x256.png_each)

existing_features.title: Add persistent, on-site disclaimers across the app stating the service is ROLEPLAY USE ONLY and NOT REAL IDENTIFICATION, and ensure the ID preview/export also includes a visible ROLEPLAY-ONLY / NOT VALID ID watermark.
Implement Internet Identity authentication for all users and gate all authenticated pages/actions behind login; show a signed-out landing screen with a clear call-to-action to sign in.

Create a coherent, dark futuristic government/military visual theme with neon cyan + purple accents, glow + scan-line animations, clean professional typography, and full responsiveness across desktop/Chromebook/mobile; apply the theme consistently across all pages and components.

Build the user dashboard UI: show the signed-in user’s order history list (order name/holder name, state, ID number, current status, created date) and provide navigation to create a new order and view an individual order’s details.

Build the ID ordering flow UI: an order form that collects all required ID fields and roleplay shipping fields, including a U.S. state dropdown, validates required inputs, and submits the order to the backend.
Implement state selection with state seal/logo support: selecting a state updates the ID card preview to show the chosen state name and corresponding seal image.
Add photo upload (image-only) with client-side validation and an auto-crop flow to an ID-photo aspect ratio; display the cropped photo in the live ID card preview and include it in export/print.

Create a live digital ID card preview component that updates as the user types and includes name, photo, state + seal, DOB, gender, height, eye color, ID number, and a subtle animated scan-line effect; ensure it visually resembles a secure ID card while remaining readable.
Implement Export & Print: allow users to export the ID card preview as a PNG image and print the ID cleanly, ensuring exported/printed output contains only the card (no surrounding UI).

Implement admin access via Internet Identity (no password): configure a backend admin allowlist of principals; add an Admin Panel UI that is visible/accessible only to admin principals and allows viewing all orders and updating any order’s status to Pending/Approved/Shipped.
Use React Query for data fetching/caching and ensure key flows invalidate/refetch appropriately (create order, update status) so UI stays in sync with backend state.

Add basic safety/clarity copy in English throughout the UI to avoid confusion with real identification (e.g., on order form and export/print screens) while keeping the “secure service” presentation style.

Add a simple public landing page that introduces RF-FALCON-IDS as a ROLEPLAY-only service, shows the visual theme, and provides entry points to sign in and learn how the ordering process works (high-level).

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement Internet Identity authentication for all users (including admin access via identity)
Create responsive UI theme: dark futuristic government/military aesthetic with neon cyan/purple accents, glow/scan-line animations, and clean typography
User dashboard showing user-specific order history and order details (users can only see their own orders)
ID ordering form capturing ID details (name, DOB, gender, height, eye color, roleplay address, ID number) plus roleplay shipping info (name, address, city, state, ZIP)
State selection dropdown with all U.S. states and associated seals/logos; update ID card display based on selected state
Photo upload (image only) with auto-crop to ID photo ratio and display in the live ID card preview
Live digital ID card preview that updates as the user types; includes photo, state seal, all ID data, and animated scan-line effect
Export generated ID card as PNG and support clean print output with no UI elements
Order persistence with default status 'Pending'; status changes reflected for users
Admin panel (admin via Internet Identity) to view all orders across users, including shipping info, and update status (Pending/Approved/Shipped) with instant user-visible updates

Implement backend order persistence in the single Motoko actor: store orders keyed by authenticated user principal, enforce that users can only create/read their own orders, and support querying all orders only for admin principals.

Define an order data model that captures: ID details (first name, last name, DOB, gender, height, eye color, roleplay residential address, state, ID number), roleplay shipping info (full name, address, city, state, ZIP), a photo field (image-only), creation timestamp, and order status (Pending/Approved/Shipped) with default Pending.
